rows.scope: Mixin bootstrap requirements of retained consumers; remove dependency only after those consumers are gone.
rows.current_evidence: Not an owned replacement. Current optional integrations may bootstrap their own mixins.
acceptance: Start the approved roster without duplicate injection or unsupported bytecode; identify every remaining consumer.

rows.scope: Target health, status, damage feedback, bounded range and visibility rules.
rows.current_evidence: HUD exists; full reference indicator behavior has not been audited.
acceptance: Real two-player combat shows correct health/status without hidden-entity disclosure or stale target bars.

rows.scope: Every reference weapon: acquisition, reach, charged/secondary action, effects, model and persistence.
rows.current_evidence: Original arsenal and rack exist; weapon-by-weapon parity remains open.
acceptance: Each observed weapon has a distinct tested action, readable presentation and normal-player acquisition.

rows.scope: Observe actual balance/progression/behavior patches and specify intended replacements individually.
rows.current_evidence: Filename 2.0 and embedded 1.7 disagree; behavior scope unresolved.
acceptance: Record each observed tweak and test its interaction with the selected owned systems; do not infer behavior from filename.

rows.scope: Resolve loader identity and actual dependency/behavior obligations before choosing an implementation.
rows.current_evidence: Embedded Example Mod and version placeholder are not a trustworthy identity.
acceptance: Observe runtime identity and dependent consumers; document a concrete replacement or justified dependency retirement.

rows.scope: Bounty dossiers, mission eligibility, target identity, contribution, payouts and public/private intel.
rows.current_evidence: Mission/journal foundations exist; complete bounty behavior is unverified.
acceptance: Correct eligible target and contributor receive exactly one payout; invalid targets and duplicate claims are refused.

rows.scope: Readable hunger/saturation and food-preview information integrated into provisions.
rows.current_evidence: Culinary runtime exists; owned saturation/preview presentation is planned.
acceptance: Compare actual eating result to preview, respect GUI scale and avoid obscuring combat information.

rows.scope: Cosmetic equipment/wardrobe, original authoring and a documented import path for permitted user-created skins.
rows.current_evidence: Original ward renderer exists; AW editor/import parity is not implemented.
acceptance: Equip/save/reload cosmetics without altering combat equipment; import only explicitly supported formats and retain source provenance.

rows.scope: Observed high-risk transformation mechanics, strain, activation, duration, counters and visuals.
rows.current_evidence: Original modes are a foundation, not verified Baryon parity.
acceptance: Costs and consequences persist through relog/death; opponents see readable tells; no free toggle exploit.

rows.scope: Nine beast-related progression paths, encounters, contracts, forms and distinct combat expression.
rows.current_evidence: Nine original ward profiles and shared encounters exist; complete beast loop/unique mechanics remain open.
acceptance: All nine have acquisition, distinct kit, counterplay, ownership recovery and real client animation evidence.

rows.scope: Observe its specific advanced techniques/entities/items and map each obligation into owned engines.
rows.current_evidence: No complete artifact-specific parity claim.
acceptance: Each observed feature has an evidence row; no assumed modern-franchise roster is marked implemented.

rows.scope: Bounded XP aggregation preserving the actual XP sum, pickup rules and progression effects.
rows.current_evidence: Not yet an owned verified equivalent.
acceptance: Stress test many XP awards with unchanged totals, party semantics and no duplicate pickup.

rows.scope: Consistent player/target health bars with configurable layout, status shapes and accessibility.
rows.current_evidence: Original HUD exists; reference-specific visual behavior remains unverified.
acceptance: Readability at multiple aspect ratios and health scales; no duplicate conflicting bars.

rows.scope: Binding search, conflict detection, remap persistence, focus and input safety.
rows.current_evidence: Controls 1.4 simple exists; full binding-search parity remains planned.
acceptance: Resolve a conflict, save/restart and verify chat/search do not fire abilities.

rows.scope: Separate cosmetic presentation from real armor stats with exact stack storage and synchronized visibility.
rows.current_evidence: Ward renderer exists; independent cosmetic-slot parity is not established.
acceptance: Equip/remove/death/reconnect preserves real combat gear, cosmetics and observer rendering without duplication.

rows.scope: Original NPC behavior/dialogue/services/schedules plus careful import or optional retention of friend-authored definitions.
rows.current_evidence: Residents has three service roles; it is not a complete CNPC runtime.
acceptance: ID/reference remap, scripts, quests, trade, faction, appearance, pathing and copied-world restart all pass for imported content.

rows.scope: Keep optional local compatibility; implement owned server/party join UX without requiring a proprietary social/account service.
rows.current_evidence: Pinned local JAR works in inspection; no redistribution permission inferred.
acceptance: Owned gameplay works without Essential; optional enabled profile still starts and connects.

rows.scope: Legacy fluid/block data compatibility and required water-bearing architecture behavior.
rows.current_evidence: Mist uses real water; arbitrary legacy fluidlogged block migration is unverified.
acceptance: Preserve source water/block identity in a test copy; no flooding, silent deletion or invented universal conversion.

rows.scope: Map actual team/library consumers to owned party/state APIs; remove only after their obligations are covered.
rows.current_evidence: Current party/reward foundations exist, not complete FTBLib parity.
acceptance: Team membership and consumers survive restart/rejoin; no abandoned library dependency remains.

rows.scope: Versioned objective graphs, chapters, party credit, rewards, repeat rules, content authoring and safe import.
rows.current_evidence: Current missions are partial foundations; full quest editor/import parity is planned.
acceptance: Normal-player chain and co-op replay work through restart; each payout is idempotent; unsupported imported objectives are explicit.

rows.scope: Document retained animation consumers and replace necessary behavior with original rigs/controllers or reviewed dependencies.
rows.current_evidence: Original cuboid ward engine exists; it is not a general GeckoLib replacement.
acceptance: Every owned actor has a tested animation contract; no transitive runtime dependency is removed prematurely.

rows.current_evidence: Original Vale wards and separate recovered hvbijuu candidate are distinct; later private legacy candidate is not installed.
acceptance: Test all forms/movement states at several frame rates and perspectives; never substitute one renderer while claiming to fix the other.

rows.scope: Bounded item/tag/metadata matching for recipes, objectives and service filters.
rows.current_evidence: Existing owned crafting/state checks cover some use cases; complete filter language is not established.
acceptance: Positive/negative metadata/NBT cases, unknown items and changed tags behave deterministically without arbitrary expressions.

rows.scope: Search, recipe/use discovery and item visibility, with retained optional JEI support during development.
rows.current_evidence: JEI is in inspection; empty-list hide bridge warning is an observed P0 fix.
acceptance: Empty/nonempty hide bridge works; owned recipe/codex search gives accurate acquisition and input handling.

rows.scope: Explain observed resource locations, mob drops and authored loot ranges without exposing hidden content.
rows.current_evidence: Planned; do not invent observed drop tables.
acceptance: Displayed sources match actual configured loot/world generation and discovery eligibility.

rows.scope: Observe each additional technique, its acquisition, timing, geometry, costs and visual identity.
rows.current_evidence: Current scroll engines cover several families; exact addon parity remains open.
acceptance: Each mapped technique completes the universal behavior record and native/two-client scenarios.

rows.scope: Audit its actual techniques, actors, upgrades and progression rather than inferring them from the title.
rows.current_evidence: Filename 5.5.8 and generic embedded 1.0.0 cannot establish mechanics coverage.
acceptance: Every observed actor/technique gets acquisition, unique mechanics, persistence and presentation proof.

rows.scope: Five village picture items, placement/support, dimensions, variants, saved entity identity and original art.
rows.current_evidence: Standards 0.3.1 has verified historical binary contract; actual production-world migration remains open.
acceptance: Existing pictures load in a copied world with correct village, support and recovery; replacement art is provenance-reviewed.

rows.scope: Full shinobi base: natures, clans, eyes, combat, movement, modes, actors, items, blocks and progression.
rows.current_evidence: 556 current items and partial mechanics do not establish base-mod parity.
acceptance: Complete per-feature ledger and normal-player campaign with unique mechanics, multiplayer and visual evidence.

rows.scope: Audit actual addon-specific equipment/techniques/entities and integrate distinct obligations.
rows.current_evidence: Some counterpart/encounter foundations exist; source-artifact mapping needs observation.
acceptance: No merged generic placeholder can close multiple unique obligations; verify actual configured behaviors.

rows.scope: Observe chakra/stat/progression additions and their interactions with the base mod.
rows.current_evidence: Embedded 1.1 differs from filename V1.3.
acceptance: Resource scaling, purchase/unlock costs, reset behavior and save/relog are specified and tested.

rows.scope: Audit enhanced-extension fixes/features and map each concrete behavior.
rows.current_evidence: Embedded 0.2.1-beta differs from filename 0.2.2-beta; no exhaustive obligation list yet.
acceptance: Reference observations distinguish a bug fix from a new ability; each accepted replacement has a regression case.

rows.scope: Retain optional local shader/rendering compatibility; owned game readability, effects and settings work without it.
rows.current_evidence: Exact local pinned JAR initialized and connected in inspection.
acceptance: Actual client tests vanilla and OptiFine separately; no private JAR is silently bundled into public distribution.

rows.scope: In-world readable journal/codex, discovery gates, localization, navigation and content authoring.
rows.current_evidence: Current technique codex/mission journal are foundations, not a full book framework.
acceptance: A novice can find acquisition, recipe and mission help without OP/debug commands; localization and navigation persist.

rows.scope: Observe path-specific abilities, sustained summons/forces, unlocks, drains, geometry and counters.
rows.current_evidence: Advanced eye-path parity is not established by current generic effects.
acceptance: Each path has distinct tested mechanics, sustained cost, loaded-chunk/protection limits and observer visuals.

rows.scope: Marks, placed seals, bindings, travel/storage/ritual semantics actually observed in reference.
rows.current_evidence: Waymark and some scroll effects are partial foundations.
acceptance: Ownership, placement, multiple targets, removal, expiry, protection and restart behave deterministically.

rows.scope: Observed eye stages and abilities, copied techniques, counters, strain and evolution paths.
rows.current_evidence: No full eye-stage/mechanic parity claim.
acceptance: Unlocks, eligible copy whitelist, information limits, form conflicts and two-client readability pass.

rows.scope: Regional ingredients, farming, processing, cooking, stations, recipes, food benefits and trade.
rows.current_evidence: Owned culinary runtime/items exist; full recipe and machine-behavior audit remains open.
acceptance: Each recipe/station has real inputs/outputs, occupied/full cases, unload/restart and valid normal-player acquisition.

rows.scope: Audit observed curse-mark and other registered content with activation/risk/progression/visual contracts.
rows.current_evidence: Embedded ahznbcursemarkaddon 5.0 differs from SpringAddon7.0 filename.
acceptance: Distinct stages/costs/counters persist and render correctly; no inferred feature is marked complete.

rows.scope: Allow intended melee through replaceable grass while preserving real obstacle/target order.

acceptance: Grass does not block a permitted target; walls, allies and nearer collision still prevent an invalid hit.

rows.scope: Identify actual consumers and replace their required settings workflows with owned validated schemas.
rows.current_evidence: Not an owned library replacement; removal depends on consumer audit.
acceptance: Invalid values are bounded; saved settings reload; no active consumer references a removed library.

rows.scope: Field pack storage, upgrades, carried/displayed state and any observed fluid/tool behavior.
rows.current_evidence: Six-slot rack is not backpack parity.
acceptance: No nested-container duplication; full inventory/death/drop/reconnect preserves every exact stack and upgrade.

rows.scope: Original furnishings/props and required gameplay blocks, plus conservative legacy saved-data support.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical combat-prop quarantine exists; complete decoration/block migration does not.
acceptance: Usable original furnishings and accurate collision; unknown legacy blocks never silently become air in a preserved world.

rows.current_evidence: Waymark is a separate personal technique, not complete named-warp parity.
acceptance: Private/unknown/unsafe destinations fail without charging; successful travel charges once and respects protection.

rows.current_evidence: Planned; current inspection teleport book is not a finished travel network.
acceptance: Discovery, destination destruction, rename, transfer, costs, cooldown and restart all preserve correct state.

rows.current_evidence: Offline schematic generators and checks exist outside this source checkout; reusable runtime template service is planned.
acceptance: Round-trip native metadata/tile entities, refuse unsafe targets, preserve rollback and reset only owned encounter cells.

rows.scope: Map dependency obligations follow the owned map/discovery UI; retain locally only for explicit compatibility tests.
rows.current_evidence: No owned replacement or redistribution inference.
acceptance: Owned discovery/map features function without the library; any retained map consumer has matching required dependencies.

rows.scope: Readable local navigation, discovered landmarks and consensual party waypoints.
rows.current_evidence: Planned; avoid inheriting radar/hidden-entity disclosures by default.
acceptance: Map orientation/scale/visibility and saved waypoints work; inaccessible rooms/enemies remain undisclosed.

rows.current_evidence: Planned; no existing full atlas parity.
